held_constant: serialized worktree creation in both primary arms
disturbance: Parallel coding agents work against one shared codebase while nine tickets form three overlapping-footprint contention clusters. Without pre-start attenuation, second/third members can branch from stale shared state and collide at integration or silently poison composed behavior.
treatment: Pre-start coordination gates dispatch of footprint-overlapping tickets until the prior overlapping ticket has integrated, so later work branches from the updated integrated state.
reported_conflict_structure: All conflicts in the two primary uncoordinated runs occur on second or third members of the designed contention clusters. The coordinated arm integrates all nine contention-cluster tickets in both primary replicates.

excluded_variant.reason: same-batch dispatch-gate bug allowed overlapping tickets admitted in one batch to race; retained in raw data and excluded from the primary comparison

causal_control_note: The same benchmark later reports that a git-only scheduler using the same pre-start check-in logic can match the coordinated Nool arm when declared footprints are accurate. This supports attribution to the coordination relation rather than to product branding alone.
vsm_interpretation: This is direct S2 capability evidence at the benchmark-defined fleet boundary: distinct S1 workers generate interaction-specific variety through overlapping concurrent work; the coordination treatment attenuates that interference before execution by delaying overlapping work; later workers then operate on integrated state, changing subsequent S1 behavior and integration outcomes. The public benchmark repository does not establish the external Nool runtime as a canonical Index harness, so this observation is non-canonical and cannot select the S2 primary baseline.

treatment: The merger receives a richer shared L0 specification that exposes the common class contract while operating on the same split-worker outputs. This shared specification attenuates the representation mismatch without changing the worker implementations themselves.

disturbance: Multiple coding agents in the parallel CodeCRDT organization update one shared code artifact concurrently. Their useful local edits create interaction-specific integration variety, including the possibility of overlapping or semantically incompatible concurrent changes.
coordination_relation: CodeCRDT supplies first-party observation-driven coordination over shared CRDT state: agents observe concurrent edits, incorporate the shared state and rely on strong eventual consistency to converge concurrent updates without a separate textual merge-resolution step.

vsm_interpretation: This is direct descriptive S2 capability evidence at the external CodeCRDT product boundary. Distinct concurrent coding activities generate interaction-specific integration variety and the first-party shared CRDT relation attenuates merge-level variety by maintaining deterministic convergence. The absence of an uncoordinated-parallel control prevents a causal effect claim, and CodeCRDT is not a canonical Index harness, so this row cannot create canonical S2 ownership or select the S2 primary baseline.

experiment: T4 Sonnet 4.6 matched-compute parallel-merge versus AgentRoom

control.description: two concurrent coding agents work independently and their outputs are unioned after execution without the AgentRoom shared coordination relation

treatment.description: two concurrent coding agents operate in the CRDT-backed shared workspace with AgentRoom MCP coordination tools and collaboration protocol

coordination_relation: AgentRoom supplies atomic file claims, shared peer/claim state, append-only room communication and a protocol that requires workers to revise their file/task plan when a claim conflicts, over a CRDT-mediated shared workspace.
comparison_limitation: The treatment is the full AgentRoom coordination bundle (CRDT shared workspace, MCP coordination tools and collaboration protocol). The smaller shared-plus-collaboration-without-MCP component probe is not used to assign a component-level causal share because its reported interval spans zero.
provenance_limitation: The paper-cited GitHub repository was not publicly recoverable through the GitHub API at review time, so no software revision, commit-level implementation provenance or canonical repository identity is inferred. The immutable public experimental record for this observation is the paper itself.
vsm_interpretation: This is direct S2 capability evidence at the paper-defined AgentRoom boundary. The control retains two concurrent coding S1s and therefore retains the interaction-generated disturbance surface, while the treatment adds a first-party coordination relation that constrains conflicting file ownership and shared-state interaction and changes subsequent worker behavior. AgentRoom is not a canonical Index harness, so the result is non-canonical and cannot select the S2 primary baseline.
